description: Implementation of QrSegment class for QR code generation, including methods for creating segments in different modes, calculating total bits, and handling character encodings.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data in a QR code, with methods for creation and analysis.

classes.name: QrSegment::Mode
classes.description: Defines encoding modes for QR segments, such as numeric, alphanumeric, byte, etc.

methods.name: makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from byte data.

methods.name: makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from a numeric string.

methods.name: makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: makeEci
methods.description: Creates a QR segment for ECI (Extended Channel Interpretation) assignment.

methods.name: getTotalBits
methods.description: Calculates total bits needed for a list of segments at a specific QR code version.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only numeric characters.
